creationInfo.comment: Written by hand from the repository contents (Makefile, deploy/deploy.sh, the imports under rig/ and deploy/, third_party/) and from the Sony Camera Remote SDK v2.02.00 package. No file-level analysis was run. Versions and licences that could not be confirmed from the SDK package or from an installed package's own metadata are recorded as NOASSERTION; the comment on each package says what was checked. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is the readable form of this document.

packages.name: wildsync
packages.summary: Control software for a multi-camera Sony ILX-LR1 underwater stereo rig.
packages.comment: Source only: ilxctl (C++17, src/) is built on the target with make; rigd and the tools (Python, rig/) run from the checkout, and deploy.sh copies piagent and its helpers to each node. The MIT licence in LICENSE covers the project's own code and documentation. It does not cover the Sony Camera Remote SDK, which is not in the repository, nor the three vendor PDFs kept for reference in docs/, which remain the copyright of their publishers (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Operating-system packages that deploy/deploy.sh installs from apt (build-essential, rsync, chrony, gpiod, libusb-1.0-0, libxml2 on the nodes; chrony and rsync on the Jetson) are infrastructure and are not listed as packages here; the Python packages among them are.

packages.name: Sony Camera Remote SDK
packages.comment: Proprietary. NOT redistributed with this project and not present in the repository or its history. Each developer obtains the package from Sony under Sony's licence agreement and stages it locally with `make sdk` (headers into include/CRSDK/, shared libraries into lib/) or `make sdk-linux` (Linux aarch64 libraries into lib-linux/, and the headers); all three directories are git-ignored. ilxctl includes the CRSDK headers and links libCr_Core, and the SDK loads its transport adapters from CrAdapter/ at run time; the build copies the libraries next to the binary. The code was built against v2.02.00. The package also ships OpenCV for Sony's sample application; this project does not stage or use that copy.

packages.name: libusb
packages.comment: Bundled inside the Sony Camera Remote SDK as CrAdapter/libusb-1.0.0.dylib (macOS) and CrAdapter/libusb-1.0.so (Linux); not in this repository. Version from libusb/version.h in the source archive Sony ships with the SDK (SourceCodeOfOpenSourceSoftware/libusb.zip: 1.0.26, nano 11724); the same version record is present in the macOS and Linux aarch64 binaries. Licence from that archive's COPYING and source file headers. Sony's SDK readme names libusb as open-source software whose licence conditions the distributor of an application must meet.

packages.name: libssh2
packages.comment: Bundled inside the Sony Camera Remote SDK as CrAdapter/libssh2.dylib (macOS) and CrAdapter/libssh2.so (Linux); not in this repository. The version is not asserted because the package is not consistent: the source archive Sony ships (SourceCodeOfOpenSourceSoftware/libssh2.zip) is 1.10.0, while the binaries identify themselves as 1.10.0 (macOS arm64) and 1.11.0 (macOS x86_64, Linux aarch64). Licence from the COPYING file in that source archive.

packages.name: OpenSSL
packages.comment: Not a separate file: statically linked into libraries of the Sony Camera Remote SDK (libssh2, and the monitor-protocol library - libmonitor_protocol on macOS, libmonitor_protocol_pf on Linux aarch64). Not in this repository. The version is not asserted because the package is not consistent: the source archive Sony ships (SourceCodeOfOpenSourceSoftware/openssl.zip) is 3.0.8, while the binaries carry the version strings 3.0.13 (libssh2) and 3.0.10 (monitor-protocol library). Licence from LICENSE.txt in that source archive.

packages.name: cpp-httplib
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) 2025 Yuji Hirose. All rights reserved.
packages.comment: Single-header HTTP server library, vendored at third_party/httplib.h and compiled into ilxctl. Version from CPPHTTPLIB_VERSION in the header; licence and copyright from the header's own notice. The file is byte-identical to SimpleCli/app/httplib.h in Sony's Camera Remote SDK v2.02.00 package.

packages.name: pyserial
packages.comment: Imported as `serial` by rig/nav.py (iKonvert NMEA 2000 gateway) and by the serial transports of rig/imu_yb.py and rig/imu_olive.py. Not pinned and not in this repository. On the Jetson it is the apt package python3-serial, installed by `deploy/deploy.sh jetson`; that version is not recorded. Licence from the installed package on the development host (pyserial 3.5: SPDX identifier in its source files).

packages.name: Pillow
packages.comment: Imported as `PIL` by rig/run.py (EXIF fallback for a frame's capture instant), rig/stereo_check.py, rig/tests/fakenode.py and the icon generators in deploy/icons/. Not pinned and not in this repository. On the Jetson it is the apt package python3-pil, installed by `deploy/deploy.sh jetson`; that version is not recorded. Licence from the installed package metadata on the development host (Pillow 12.3.0).

packages.name: numpy
packages.licenseDeclared: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
packages.comment: Imported by the calibration and VSLAM tools (rig/rigcal.py, rig/vslam.py, rig/stereo_check.py) and their self-tests. Not pinned and not in this repository. On the Jetson it is the apt package python3-numpy, installed by `deploy/deploy.sh jetson`; that version is not recorded. Licence expression from the installed package metadata on the development host (numpy 2.5.2); an older distribution package may declare a different expression.

packages.name: OpenCV (Python bindings)
packages.comment: Imported as `cv2` by the calibration and VSLAM tools (rig/rigcal.py, rig/vslam.py, rig/stereo_check.py) and their self-tests. Not pinned and not in this repository. On the Jetson it is the apt package python3-opencv, installed by `deploy/deploy.sh jetson`; that version is not recorded. On a macOS or development host it is the pip wheel opencv-python-headless. Licence from that wheel's metadata on the development host (opencv-python-headless 5.0.0.93, declared Apache 2.0); the wheel's own packaging scripts are MIT and it bundles further third-party libraries listed in its LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt.

packages.name: gpiod (libgpiod Python bindings)
packages.comment: Imported as `gpiod` by rig/piagent.py for the FOCUS/TRIGGER lines on each camera node and for the strobe line on the Jetson. Linux only; not in this repository. It is the apt package python3-libgpiod, installed by `deploy/deploy.sh provision` on a node and `deploy/deploy.sh strobe` on the Jetson. The version given is the libgpiod API the code is written against and the one docs/PROTOCOL.md specifies for the nodes (Ubuntu 24.04); the version on the Jetson (Ubuntu 22.04) is not recorded. The licence is not asserted: the package is not installed on the host where this document was written, so it could not be read from package metadata.
